headline: Deadlocked's new proposals cover networking, Battledome and shared game code
summary: Eight pull requests opened for Ratchet: Deadlocked, but none merged and no commits landed on main. Their authors report matches for NTSC-U v1.00 and PAL. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: #166 proposes 348 matched functions for NTSC-U v1.00, with 336 also matching PAL.
#159 proposes 25 matched functions for NTSC-U v1.00, with 23 also matching PAL.
Networking proposals for NTSC-U v1.00 report 58 functions in #160, 41 in #162 and 25 in #163, covering sockets, packets and session requests.
#165 proposes 99 NTSC-U v1.00 functions across game, network and core code.
PAL proposals #161 and #164 each report 20 new functions. They cover core and shared code, networking and Battledome.
